JSJ is great! I've heard nothing but good things about her/him and I've looked at all the gradesheets of BIO103 of last sem and saw that Jsj gives out better grades than both NSI and SKK.
About FHM, remember 1 rule- SIZE MATTERS. 
 I got an A- from her without studying much. What you do is study some and improvise a lot. If she asks for a short note on internet governance for eg, and you have not the slightest clue what it's about use your common sense and be creative. Even if you're wrong you will get at least 80% of the marks on that question. I got full marks on all of her short notes worth 1 mark using this method and 4/5 on her broad questions.
